title: Quantification of Craniofacial Growth Pattern Based on Deep Learning.
summary: EfficientNet-based age and sex estimates from 41,625 cephalometric radiographs quantified craniofacial growth-related patterns. The retrospective single-center image result does not establish a causal growth mechanism.
